summary: Remove Record Relation: severs a link between a target record and a named relation field of an owner record.
description: The inverse of Add Record Relation: when `store` fires, the record in `targetId` is removed from the configured relation field of the record in `modelId`. `done` confirms the server accepted it — including when the relation was not there to begin with, which this node cannot tell apart from a real unlink — and `completed` follows it; `failure`/`error` report problems. Removing a relation never deletes either record — it only unlinks them.
whenToUse: Undoing relation links: leaving a project, unfavouriting, untagging. To delete the record itself use Delete Record.

ports.modelId: Id of the owner record whose relation field loses a link.
ports.targetId: Id of the record being unlinked.
ports.done: Signal; the unlink was confirmed by the server.
ports.completed: Signal; fires after every Do whatever the outcome — wire it to carry on regardless.

runtimeBehavior: Class and relation-name configuration is schema-driven exactly as on Add Record Relation (declared-port-groups + runtime-discovered); ports depend on the project's database schema.
